title: outputs.json
description: R-D7: the index of artifacts the code produced. Choice where the plan is silent: the file is an object {"outputs": [...]} (so it can grow top-level fields), one entry per artifact. `path` is relative to the run directory and must exist (checked by run-check). Every `output` event is also an entry here: the file is the index, the event is the notification. `format` is free text (hdf5, openpmd, jls, csv, bin+toml, ...). `schema` is the path of a sidecar describing the format (Vespa's fields.toml).
